theme_and_art_direction.description: An award-worthy, highly kinetic, 'Awwwards Site-of-the-Day' level design. Fuses the raw, heavy impact of Brutalist typography with the refined, cinematic elegance of editorial fashion photography. It relies heavily on extreme typography scales, razor-sharp contrasts, and liquid-smooth scroll motion. The aesthetic is unapologetically bold, designed to make users feel the weight and prestige of the 4-11 Studio brand before they even read the copy.
theme_and_art_direction.theme_preference: System default with a manual Dark/Light toggle. Design is primarily anchored in Deep Void Black for maximum drama, but must elegantly invert for light mode.

colors.strategy: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with Luxury. No AI-slop gradients. 95% monochromatic with a single, aggressive accent color used sparingly for tension.
rules: NEVER use generic purple-on-white or full-screen gradients.
Background must be solid #0a0a0a (Dark) or #fcfcfc (Light), with a subtle CSS noise/grain overlay spanning the entire viewport to kill 'digital flatness'.
Accent color (#FF3B00) is reserved ONLY for interaction highlights (hover states, active input borders, tiny geometric decorative shapes like an asterisk or a dot).

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule: High-tension pairings. Massive Sans-Serif + Elegant Italic Serif + Monospace Tech details.

headings.usage: Massive headlines, numbers, capability titles. Tracking must be extremely tight (tracking-tighter).

editorial_accent.usage: Used strictly in italics for manifesto keywords and high-end emotional contrast alongside Clash Display.

utility.usage: Countdown timer numbers, registered brands counter, tiny labels (e.g., [ 01 ], [ SCROLL ]). Always uppercase, tracking-widest.

body.usage: Paragraphs, form inputs, button text. Readable and clean.

scale_hierarchy.h2_section: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl leading-none tracking-tight uppercase

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Extreme breathing room. Minimum padding between major sections should be py-24 or py-32.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Strict adherence to asymmetrical spans.
rules: Do not center-align everything. Default to stark left-alignment to establish a strong reading edge.
Use heavy borders (1px solid border-border) to divide sections or create structural 'blueprint' vibes.
Images must be in clipped frames (e.g., aspect-[3/4] or aspect-[16/9] with overflow-hidden). No rounded corners on main containers; keep edges brutal and sharp (rounded-none).

hero_reveal.implementation: Wrap each line of the H1 in an overflow-hidden container. Animate the text inside from `y: '100%'` to `y: 0` with a duration of 1.2s, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1], and a stagger of 0.15s between lines.

parallax_scrolling.description: Images should have a subtle parallax inside their clipped frames.
parallax_scrolling.implementation: Scale image to 120% and translate Y based on scroll position using Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform.

hover_states.images: group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700 ease-out inside an overflow-hidden wrapper.
hover_states.buttons: Relative overflow-hidden. On hover, a background block (accent color) slides up from the bottom, and text color inverts. Use standard transform transitions, not 'all'.

1_header.layout: Fixed top, z-50, mix-blend-difference (if applicable) or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70).
1_header.elements: Left: '4-11 STUDIO' logo (font-headings). Right: Dark/Light Theme Toggle + 'Submit Brief' anchor link.

2_kinetic_hero.layout: h-screen flex flex-col justify-end pb-12 px-6 sm:px-12 relative overflow-hidden.
elements: Background: Massive 3D/Abstract sculpture image playing the role of a subtle parallax backdrop, heavily darkened/tinted.
Middle: Live Countdown Timer (Days/Hrs/Mins/Secs) in Monospace.
Foreground (Bottom): Massive kinetic text 'MUMBAI', 'CAMPAIGN', 'ENGINE' stacked. Masked reveal on load.

3_manifesto_chapters.layout: py-32 px-6 sm:px-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 border-t border-border.
elements: Left col (span 4): Sticky '[ 01 ] THE PIPELINE' mono label.
Right col (span 8): Large manifesto copy using Clash Display intermixed with Playfair Display italics for key words (e.g., 'Scaling *creator presence*. Producing *unforgettable* live events.').
Accordion or Hover-reveal list. Items: Social Media Marketing, YouTube Strategy, Influencer Activation, Event Production.
Interaction: Hovering over a list item reveals/changes an associated image in a fixed or absolute positioned clipped frame nearby (spotlight effect).

5_editorial_marquee.layout: py-12 border-y border-border overflow-hidden bg-foreground text-background.
5_editorial_marquee.elements: react-fast-marquee running text: 'CREATIVE PIPELINE • MUMBAI • 4-11 STUDIO • NEXT MAJOR REVEAL • '. Font: Clash Display, uppercase, huge.

6_founders.layout: py-24 px-6 sm:px-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12.
elements: Image of founders (cinematic portrait) in a 3/4 aspect ratio clipped frame.

7_lead_capture.layout: py-32 px-6 sm:px-12 max-w-4xl mx-auto border-t border-border
elements: Counter: '384 Brands Registered' (Monospace utility font, counting up animation on scroll).
Form: Minimalist 'Submit Brief' inputs. border-b only, no side borders (HTML input styling overridden with Tailwind). Submit button is a massive full-width block.

8_footer.layout: py-12 px-6 sm:px-12 flex justify-between items-end bg-background text-foreground.
8_footer.elements: Massive '4-11' logo on the left, social links on the right.

hero_background_parallax.usage: Use as a large, subtle background element in the hero, darkened heavily so the text pops.

capability_event.usage: Image to show when hovering over 'Event Production' capability.

founders_portrait.alt: Cinematic portrait of two men in studio
founders_portrait.usage: Founders section photo, treated deliberately (spotlight, clipped frame).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling wrapping the App.
Ensure global CSS uses Google Fonts for Clash Display (or similar wide alternative if not on Google Fonts, like Cabinet Grotesk or Anton), Playfair Display, JetBrains Mono, and Manrope.
Implement the dark/light mode context or use Tailwind's dark class toggle.
DO NOT use standard Shadcn card containers for this marketing page. Use raw HTML+Tailwind for asymmetrical layouts.
Images MUST have absolute overlays if text is placed on them (bg-black/40 or gradient), but prefer placing text outside images in this brutalist design.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
For the form, use Shadcn UI Input but strip the borders on left, top, right (border-0 border-b border-border rounded-none bg-transparent) to fit the minimal editorial vibe.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, not just shadows.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep layouts deliberately asymmetric.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
